doc.section_path: Chapter on pharmaceutical establishments
doc.text: [Demo paraphrase, not the official text] A pharmaceutical establishment may only operate under a licence issued by the competent authority, and the licence names the person responsible.

doc.section_path: Chapter on medical products
doc.text: [Demo paraphrase, not the official text] A medical product may only be marketed after it is registered and a marketing authorisation is issued by the competent authority.

doc.section_path: 3.2 Finished pharmaceutical products > 3.2.6 Storage conditions
doc.text: [Demo paraphrase, not the official text] 3.2.6 Storage conditions. The conditions below apply to finished pharmaceutical products intended for hot and humid climates.

doc.section_path: 3.2 Finished pharmaceutical products > 3.2.6 Storage conditions > 3.2.6.1 Long-term
doc.text: [Demo paraphrase, not the official text] 3.2.6.1 General case. The application should include long-term testing at 30 C / 65% RH for a minimum of 12 months on at least three primary batches, with accelerated data at 40 C / 75% RH for 6 months.

doc.section_path: 3.2 Finished pharmaceutical products > 3.2.6 Storage conditions > 3.2.6.2 Intermediate
doc.text: [Demo paraphrase, not the official text] 3.2.6.2 Where long-term data was generated at other conditions, the applicant should justify why it represents the intended storage climate.
